stageSummary: We’re getting the project foundation in place before design and development begin.

phases.title: Getting started
phases.description: Project setup, agreement, initial payment, and the information needed to begin.

steps.label: Project agreement
steps.detail: Review the agreement, then use the link to add your signature.

steps.label: Pay initial deposit
steps.detail: Choose your preferred payment schedule and submit the first payment to begin the project.

steps.label: Gather product/menu information
steps.detail: Send us the product or menu list, including names, descriptions, pricing, and available options. (Don't worry if you don't have everything available right now. We can help walk you through it if you need assistance.)

steps.label: Gather product photography
steps.detail: Send us the original, highest-resolution product photos currently available.

steps.label: Confirm pickup, delivery, and shipping details
steps.detail: Share the planned pickup, delivery, and shipping areas, fees, timing, and policies.

phases.title: Brand + content
phases.description: Finalize the visual direction, products, imagery, copy, and store information.

phases.title: Website + store build
phases.description: Design and build the Sweet Gems website, store, and customer ordering experience.

phases.title: Review + revisions
phases.description: Review the complete site, refine the details, and test everything before launch.

phases.title: Launch + handoff
phases.description: Go live, complete final checks, and hand over the tools and training needed to manage the site.
